`SnapGeometry.cs` is adapted from the user's local WitchDrawer source, under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. The namespace is changed for GlassDock; the snapping algorithm is retained. The accompanying `LICENSE.txt` contains the original terms.

The mapping-reference model, adaptive-size mode, alignment-line overlay, and drag lifecycle were also reviewed in WitchDrawer. GlassDock integrates them with its existing JSON reference store, D3D11 Liquid Glass renderer and desktop window policy. No WitchDrawer database, storage-box file moves, updater, telemetry, or runtime dependency is introduced.
